mentions.name: CrewChief
mentions.description: An iPhone automotive diagnostic app that scans OBD2 diagnostic codes and hooks them up to a custom AI diagnostic prompt. It tracks vehicle repair tasks, provides easy access to VIN info for parts search and DMV records, and generates in-depth diagnostic reports: a code database includes manufacturer-specific DTCs for 10 major makes plus per-model data down to the generation level (known failure patterns, common codes per engine), with AI reports conditioned on the exact year/make/model/engine. Repair price calculations mix fetched parts price data with a guided prompt using published labor-hour records and regional averages. It speaks generic OBD2 (ELM327) over Bluetooth, so cheap adapters work.
mentions.problem: The builder wanted a single tool to track vehicle tasks, easily access VIN info for parts search, and DMV records, and saw nothing on the market with comparable depth of diagnostic reporting.
mentions.audience: Car, motorcycle, tractor, and truck owners doing their own vehicle diagnostics and repairs
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been building the most advanced automotive diagnostic app on the market

I used to be a mechanic, and spend a lot of my free time working on project vehicles, motorcycles, tractors, trucks etc. I wanted a tool to track the tasks I needed done, then a way to easily access VIN info for parts search, then I DMV records, and finally built an iphone app to scan the OBD2 diagnostic codes and hook them up to a custom ai diagnostic prompt.
